PC: This patient is type I diabetic, and as such needs a long-acting insulin on board.
MK: However, holding all insulin could push her into diabetic ketoacidosis.
ICS: Whatever changes you make to the medication, remember to tell the day team about it when you sign the patient back out to them, as they may want to change it back.
PROF: It is advisable not to discontinue a medication unless you understand why it was started and the benefits and consequences of discontinuing it.
